# FriesenByte

> FriesenByte breaks down complex code through practical programming tutorials, code snippets, and best practices across multiple languages and technologies.

FriesenByte is a developer-focused blog covering Git workflows, JavaScript, Java, C#, PHP, and .NET with hands-on guides and error solutions. The site emphasizes practical tutorials and code examples for web development, version control, and backend frameworks.

## Key Topics

- Git
- JavaScript
- Java
- C#
- .NET
- PHP
- SQL
- Laravel
- Version Control
- Web Development
- Programming Tutorials
- Code Snippets
- Bash
- IIS
- Backend Frameworks

## Getting Started

- [FriesenByte | Build-Deploy-Repeat!](https://friesenbyte.pages.dev): FriesenByte homepage: breaking down complex code through programming tutorials and code snippets.
- [Posts](https://friesenbyte.pages.dev/posts): Posts archive covering Git, .NET, JavaScript, C# and web development tutorials.

## Git Tutorials

- [Difference between git add -A and git add](https://friesenbyte.pages.dev/posts/difference-between-git-add-a-and-git-add): Git tutorial explaining differences between git add -A and git add commands.
- [git push --force-with-lease vs --force](https://friesenbyte.pages.dev/posts/git-push-force-with-lease-vs-force): Git best practices comparing force-push variants for safe version control collaboration.

## JavaScript & Web Development

- [Get difference between 2 dates in JavaScript duplicate](https://friesenbyte.pages.dev/posts/get-difference-between-2-dates-in-javascript): JavaScript guide for calculating date differences using Moment.js and date libraries.
- [How to convert an array into an object](https://friesenbyte.pages.dev/posts/how-to-convert-an-array-into-an-object): JavaScript tutorial on array-to-object conversion using reduce and Lodash.

## Backend & Database

- [How do I get the query builder to output its raw SQL query as a string](https://friesenbyte.pages.dev/posts/how-do-i-get-the-query-builder-to-output-its-raw-sql-query-as-a-string): Database debugging guide for Knex.js and Sequelize query builder raw SQL output.
- [How to get the current datetime in Java duplicate](https://friesenbyte.pages.dev/posts/how-to-get-the-current-date-time-in-java): Java guide for getting current date/time using java.time API and LocalDateTime.
